referral_code.description: The code a person's invite to yaks.app carries: whoever signs up sending it was invited by them.
referral_code.$comment: The code a person's invite carries (referral.ts `words`), on their own row, minted the first time their invite page opens. Unique, so a code names one person and the sign-up that sends it finds them.

referral.description: One person who signed up for yaks.app through another's invite: who invited them.
referral.$comment: One person who signed up through another's invite (referral.ts `credit`): who invited them. Its eid is derived from the invitee, so a person is invited once, by whoever's code their first message carried; its `created` stamp is when.

rewarded.description: The free month of the Plus plan a referral gave its inviter's space when the invitee built their first app.
rewarded.$comment: The month of the Plus plan a referral gave its inviter once the invitee built their first app (referral.ts `rewarding`): when, to which space, the day that space's free time now runs through, and, for a space already paying, the provider's subscription whose next charge moved a month later. A mark, written once.

comped.description: The Plus plan given to a space free, through `until`, with nothing billed for it.
comped.$comment: The Plus plan given to a space free, through `until`, where the payment provider bills it nothing (plans.ts `tierOf`): each reward adds a month after the later of now and the free time it already had.

plan_trial.description: A space's 30-day trial of the Plus plan, whose clock stops while its owners are away.
plan_trial.$comment: A space's trial of the Plus plan (D-476, @yaks/platform/trial): when it began and the day it ends, moved later by each time its owners were away; when its clock stopped, none while it runs; when it last started again; when the space subscribed during it, which gave the early credit once; and the notes its owners were sent, by key. Running, paused or ended is computed from these. The platform's to write.

reward_referral.description: give an invitee's inviter a free month of the Plus plan when the invitee builds their first app
reward_referral.$comment: An app made in a space whose owner was invited gives their inviter the month, the first time (facets/directory-effects.ts).

chat_dm.description: A direct message to the platform bot, kept for up to seven days while it waits for its sender’s Operator. A receipt prevents a Gateway replay from taking it twice.

chat_dm_arrived.description: carry a direct message to the sender’s Operator or offer to link their account

chat_linked.description: re-read what a chat account's guest raised as its person's once they link it, so a request within their role goes on without waiting for anyone
chat_linked.$comment: A person's own chat account linked: what its guest raised before is re-read as theirs in each space they sit in (chat.ts `linkedNow`).

support_reply.description: carry the platform's answer in a support thread to the person's Updates and to the Operator conversation or connector agent it came from, until each takes it
support_reply.$comment: The platform's answer in a support thread, or its completion, carried to the thread's person (support-reply.ts).
